traditional: No classical doctrine: Neptune is a modern planet unknown to traditional astrology. Read from the modern and cyclic layers; treat this contact as a slow, generational background tone.
modern: Structure meets dream. Grounding imagination into reality, or pessimism colliding with illusion. Fused, these drives are difficult to separate and ask to be consciously integrated rather than acted out blindly.

cyclic.meaning: A new cycle of limit and imagination is sown: instinctive, full of potential, not yet conscious of itself.

business: Concentrated focus in this area. Disciplined vision realized over time; the task is managing fear.
shadow: Fear and rigidity fused with illusion and escapism, with no distance to tell them apart.
arcApplying: The two fuse and intensify as they close in.
arcSeparating: The fused theme peaks and discharges.
